message.jaymospowers.zfighter_limit_high: Limit Break past tier 3 only holds in base form or Super.
talk.jaymospowers.master.style: Every fighter finds one way that is theirs. Choose well: only a wish to the dragon will let you learn another.
talk.jaymospowers.master.style.fury: Fury: unbroken hits stack harder and harder
talk.jaymospowers.master.style.flow: Flowing Ki: every cooldown is a quarter shorter
talk.jaymospowers.master.style.predator: Predator: more harm to a foe under half health
talk.jaymospowers.master.style.last_stan: Last Stand: near the end, you mend and land heavy blows
talk.jaymospowers.master.style.guardian: Guardian: take part of a nearby friend's harm on yourself
talk.jaymospowers.master.style.mender: Mender: your ki mends hurt friends near you
talk.jaymospowers.master.style.ki_fist: Ki and Fist: after a ki technique, your next punches hit harder
talk.jaymospowers.master.style.bulwark: Bulwark: tougher and harder to move, a little slower
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_style_forg: Your fighting style slips away. A master can teach you another.
wish.jaymospowers.zfighter.restyle.desc: Your fighting style is forgotten, so a master can teach you another. Refused if you never learned one.
talk.jaymospowers.zfighter.potential: Ask for the rite that wakes your potential
message.jaymospowers.zfighter_potential_: Not yet. Master your strongest form first; what isn't mastered can't be woken.
The rite is held at night. Come back when it's dark.
You sit through the night, and by morning your strongest form's strength is yours without the form: no blaze, no drain.
